skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo of 24% ATK DMG to each enemy in the entire row, and heals self for 20% of max HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo of 24% ATK DMG to each enemy in the entire row, and heals self for 30% of max HP, while also having a 50% chance to heal allies in the same row.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20%. As long as Smile Man is on the field, whenever he heals himself, he also heals allies in his column for 80% of the amount healed.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20%. As long as Smile Man is on the field, whenever he heals himself, he also heals allies in his column for 100% of the amount healed.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20%. As long as Smile Man is on the field, whenever he heals himself, he also heals allies in his column for 110% of the amount healed.
